text:
Sam W: heads up — convertcli failed on onboarding nebula-13b-chat from HF, hitting safetensors shard/index mismatch PLUS a 403 during a retry. repro + logs below

Sam W: repro steps:
1) hf_hub download snapshot (private org repo)
2) run `rw-convert --input /tmp/nebula --out /mnt/models/nebula-13b-chat`

Sam W: log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T14:02:11.342Z ERROR convert: shard index mismatch: expected 16 shards but found 15 in index.json
2026-03-18T14:02:11.344Z WARN  downloader: received 403 on blob download, retrying with refreshed token
2026-03-18T14:02:11.360Z ERROR downloader: retry failed, fallback attempted but revision param lost; blob path returned different shard ordering
```

Meera P: hmm. two things to separate: (A) index.json vs actual shard count mismatch — could be partial snapshot (403 interrupted listing), (B) revpin lost on retry is new to me, but i've seen similar with the hub client backoff. did you use HF_HUB_TOKEN or anonymous?

Sam W: used CI ephemeral token (HF_HUB_TOKEN set), token rotated by runner midway. i think the downloader retried with cached url that no longer included the revision query param.

Ben K: :eyes: that matches a bug i raised last month — when auth refresh happens we reconstruct the download URL but forget to include `revision=` on the S3 presigned fallback. result: the index we fetch on fallback is the repo HEAD snapshot (different shard layout) not the pinned revision.

Sam W: so that explains index mismatch. how do we fix in prod quickly?

Meera P: short-term workaround: pre-download the entire snapshot with hf_hub_download (pin the revision explicitly) and point convertcli at the local dir. longer-term: add a guard in downloader — if a retry changes revision or size, fail fast instead of silently accepting mismatch.

Convert-Bot: conversion job 22876 started by Sam W

Sam W: also seeing quantization/regression symptoms after forcing convert with --allow-fallback-keys. some special tokens got renamed (like <usr> -> [USR]) which breaks chat template alignment and causes generation drift.

Ben K: weight key rename is a separate mapping issue — new HF model uses `lm_head.weight` whereas convert pipeline expects `lm_head` keys flattened. we should canonicalize weight-name mappings in the converter index step and emit a translation table.

Meera P: is there a quick script to detect special token mismatches?

Sam W: i ran this quick check:
```
python - <<PY
from pathlib import Path
import json
m = json.load(open('/tmp/nebula/tokenizer.json'))
print('special_tokens_map', m.get('special_tokens_map'))
PY
```
it showed the chat template tokens under `additional_special_tokens` but not present in `special_tokens_map` — converter currently only reads `special_tokens_map` which is why they were dropped.

Ben K: ok — three followups: (1) downloader revpin bug (priority P1), (2) converter should prefer `additional_special_tokens` fallback when `special_tokens_map` missing (P2), (3) make convertcli validation fail if shard count != index and no explicit --force flag (P2).

Meera P: agreed. can someone open an infra bug for the downloader auth/revpin regression? i can take the tokenizer fallback patch.

Ben K: opening INFRA-9876 now. adding notes: repro archive in /tmp/nebula-debug-22876, include hub logs and presigned urls (redact tokens).

Sam W: thanks. quick mitigation steps for the onboarding team:
- export HF_HUB_TOKEN with long-lived read perms
- pre-download snapshot with `hf_hub_download(repo_id, revision=..., local_dir=...)`
- run `rw-convert --validate-only` before full convert to catch shard/key mismatches

Infra-Bot: INFRA-9876 created by Ben K — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-9876

Meera P: i'll send a tiny PR to accept `additional_special_tokens` as fallback and add a small unit test. Sam — can you attach the tokenizer.json you used to the ticket?

Sam W: attached to INFRA-9876. thanks all :thumbsup:

Ben K: one more note — if anyone hits silent quality regressions after quantization, run `rw-eval --compare baseline.json new.json --promptset chat-stability` to get token-level diffs. saved me twice.

Sam W: will do. ping me if you need the CI logs.

Meera P: thanks — moving to triage. :thinking_face:
